name: Biomech Pilot
body:
Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (nature) 1 rank, bonded mech* or ability to craft a mech.

Benefit(s): Your mech is at least partially biological, if not completely so, and as a result has access to many additional abilities. Such entities are known as “biomechs” and possess the biomech template*. The following Mech Enhancements can be selected by a mech pilot with this feat in addition to regular Mech Enhancements: Adrenaline Surge: The mech gains the ferocity universal monster ability.

Accessible Physiology: For the purpose of spells and powers, the mech pilot may treat their mech as either construct or one of humanoid, aberration, or plant (chosen when this enhancement is selected), whichever is most beneficial.
Feral Mech: The mech treats all integrated light melee weapons as natural attacks for the purpose of feats and other abilities.
Gushing Fluid: When damaged, the mech violently pours forth vitriolic fluid that hoses its attacker. When the mech takes damage from a slashing or piercing weapon, all creatures adjacent to the mech must succeed at a Reflex save (DC is 10 + the mech’s Hit Dice + the pilot’s Strength modifier) or take acid damage as its caustic fluids spray forth. A mech deals an amount of acid damage in this way based on its size (1d4 points of acid damage for a Medium or smaller mech, 1d6 for a Large mech, 1d8 for a Huge mech, 2d6 for a Gargantuan mech, and 3d6 for a Colossal mech).
Improved Feral Mech: The mech gains the pounce ability, but only with integrated weapons. The pilot must be at least 11th level and must have given the mech the feral Mech Enhancement to select this enhancement.
Instinctive Action: If the mech’s pilot becomes unconscious, stunned, or otherwise unable to pilot the mech, the mech continues to repeat the last action that it performed, attacking the nearest creature if it attacked or running if it ran. The mech is considered to have an intelligence score of – and a Wisdom score of 10 while acting in this way.
Tissue Regeneration: The mech gains fast healing equal to 1/2 its HD, its biological components pulling themselves together under stress. The mech can heal up to 2 hit points per pilot level per day with this ability, after which it ceases to function.

Special: If you possess this feat as well as the ability to craft constructs, you may craft constructs with the biomech template and create mechs that use the Mech Enhancements listed above.
